quality_assessment: Chapter is well-written and accurate with comprehensive examples. Minor gaps in documenting all compression formats supported by -z/--search-zip.

issues.description: Chapter mentions common compression formats but doesn't list all formats supported by -z/--search-zip
issues.current_content: Built-in support for common compressed formats (gzip, bzip2, xz, lz4, lzma, brotli, zstd)
issues.should_be: Built-in support includes: gzip (.gz, .tgz), bzip2 (.bz2, .tbz2), xz (.xz, .txz), lz4 (.lz4), lzma (.lzma), brotli (.br), zstd (.zst, .zstd), and uncompress (.Z)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a comprehensive list of all file extensions supported by -z/--search-zip in the comparison table or nearby text

issues.description: Chapter doesn't mention .txz (xz-compressed tar) and .Z (Unix compress) extensions
issues.current_content: Note mentions -z supports gzip, bzip2, xz, lz4, lzma, brotli, zstd
issues.should_add: Also mention that .txz (xz tarball) and .Z (Unix compress) extensions are supported
issues.fix_suggestion: Add .txz and .Z to the list of supported formats in line 231

issues.description: Example only shows Zstandard decompression, could show more formats
issues.should_add: Could add examples for other compression formats or reference the full list
issues.fix_suggestion: Either expand the example to show handling multiple compression types or add a note referencing the complete list of formats handled by -z

issues.description: Could mention that -z also spawns processes but is optimized compared to --pre
issues.should_add: Clarify that -z/--search-zip also spawns decompression processes but uses optimized matching
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a note that -z has similar process-spawning overhead but with built-in glob matching for known extensions

Good security coverage including CVE-2021-3013 and safe scripting practices
Accurate documentation of --pre and --pre-glob flag behavior matching implementation
Helpful comparison table explaining when to use -z vs --pre
Multiple real-world use cases: PDFs, encrypted files, encoding conversion, Office documents
Good troubleshooting section with common issues and solutions
Accurate example scripts that match the patterns shown in the flag documentation
